body.question: Does offloading KV blocks to a CPU tier at the shipped 0.9 GPU-utilization threshold lower p99 TTFT on the shared-prefix workload?
body.hypothesis: a CPU tier of 1/3 the GPU blocks at --kv-offload-threshold 0.9 lowers p99 TTFT by more than 2x the noise SD

target_system.name: llm-d inference scheduler in BLIS
target_system.description: llm-d inference scheduler simulated in BLIS. Arms: --kv-cpu-blocks 0 vs 1/3 of the GPU blocks, --kv-offload-threshold 0.9. Metric: p99 TTFT over the measurement window, warm-up excluded. Never modify the BLIS binary or catalog.

limitations: the workload's working set fits in cache
